title: MoE-Enhanced Explainable Deep Manifold Transformation for Complex Data Embedding and Visualization
abstract: arXiv:2410.19504v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Dimensionality reduction (DR) plays a crucial role in various fields, including data engineering and visualization, by simplifying complex datasets while retaining essential information. However, achieving both high DR accuracy and strong explainability remains a fundamental challenge, especially for users dealing with high-dimensional data. Traditional DR methods often face a trade-off between precision and transparency, where optimizing for performance can lead to reduced explainability, and vice versa. This limitation is especially prominent in real-world applications such as image, tabular, and text data analysis, where both accuracy and explainability are critical. translated_title: 基于MoE的可解释深度流形变换用于复杂数据嵌入与可视化
translated_abstract: 维度约简（DR）在数据工程和可视化等多个领域发挥着关键作用，通过简化复杂数据集同时保留重要信息。然而，实现高DR准确性和强可解释性仍然是一个基本挑战，尤其是对于处理高维数据的用户而言。传统DR方法常常面临精度与透明度之间的权衡，优化性能可能导致可解释性降低，反之亦然。这一限制在图像、表格和文本数据分析等实际应用中尤为突出，因为这些场景中准确性和可解释性都至关重要。为解决这些挑战，本工作引入了基于MoE的可解释深度流形变换（DMT-ME）。所提出的方法将几何感知的双曲映射器与专家混合（MoE）模型相结合，其中稀疏专家特化提供了
tldr: 本文提出DMT-ME方法，通过结合双曲映射和专家混合模型，在保持高维度约简精度的同时增强可解释性，解决了复杂数据嵌入与可视化中的精度-透明度权衡问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DMT-ME, which combines hyperbolic mapping with Mixture of Experts to achieve high dimensionality reduction accuracy while enhancing explainability, addressing the precision-transparency trade-off in complex data embedding and visualization.
